def print_next_greater_freq(arr, n):
    from collections import defaultdict
    freq = defaultdict(int)
    stack = []
    result = [-1] * n
    
    for i in range(n):
        freq[arr[i]] += 1
        
        while stack and freq[arr[stack[-1]]] < freq[arr[i]]:
            result[stack.pop()] = arr[i]
        
        stack.append(i)
    
    return result

# Example usage:
n = int(input())
arr = list(map(int, input().split()))
print(*print_next_greater_freq(arr, n))
